statusLegend.done: Shared source exists and no OpenClaw-only source paths were found for this domain.
statusLegend.partial: Both repos have this domain, but OpenClaw has additional source paths or tests to map.
statusLegend.missing: OpenClaw has this domain and CoreBlow has no shared source path for it.
statusLegend.intentionally_different: CoreBlow-only domain; keep only when it is a deliberate CoreBlow product or architecture surface.

behaviorDecisionLegend: A domain can remain partial while a specific shared path deliberately keeps CoreBlow behavior that differs from OpenClaw.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw grants default OpenAI-compatible operator scopes to shared-secret bearer requests.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow requires an explicitly declared operator.read scope for shared-secret bearer model-list requests.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Preserve least-privilege scope enforcement on the model discovery surface.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw validates OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_* env var compatibility scenarios.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps gateway auth env var contracts under COREBLOW_* naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid promoting OpenClaw-branded environment variables as CoreBlow public API.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps remote URL and insecure private WS opt-in under CoreBlow-branded configuration.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Preserve CoreBlow product naming on gateway connection and security knobs.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps insecure WS compatibility decisions on CoreBlow-branded configuration.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid adding OpenClaw-branded security bypass flags as canonical CoreBlow API.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw tests SecretRef precedence against OPENCLAW env variables.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow validates SecretRef precedence against CoreBlow config/env naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep auth precedence semantics without adopting OpenClaw public env names.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw rejects disallowed x-openclaw-model provider overrides.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses CoreBlow-branded request headers for provider override behavior.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep OpenAI-compatible behavior while avoiding OpenClaw-branded headers.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow request context channel headers use CoreBlow naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Message-channel request context is parity behavior, but public header naming is CoreBlow-native.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw passes x-openclaw-message-channel through OpenAI-compatible HTTP.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow preserves message-channel behavior with CoreBlow header naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid exposing OpenClaw-branded HTTP headers as CoreBlow contract.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep the public compatibility surface aligned with CoreBlow product naming.
